name: Omnifood
description: Omnifood is A virtual food Delivery network that's build by a Web Developer to learn the Concepts of HTML5, CSS3, JS and frameworks like jQuery.

paragraphs: Omnifood is a responsive, single-page website for a fictional food delivery service. This project was built to practice and demonstrate fundamental and advanced concepts in front-end web development, including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery.
features: Fully Responsive Design: Adapts to desktops, tablets, and mobile devices using CSS media queries for a seamless user experience on any screen size.
Sticky Navigation: The navigation bar becomes fixed at the top of the viewport upon scrolling for easy access to different sections.
Smooth Scrolling: Implements seamless scrolling animations for all internal navigation links.
Scroll-Triggered Animations: Elements animate into view as the user scrolls down the page, implemented using the jQuery Waypoints plugin to enhance user engagement.
Mobile Navigation: A hamburger menu for smaller screens that toggles a slide-down navigation menu.
